shot: Title card: Second Look logo, tagline, 'Build With AI: Basics'.
lines: This is Second Look: a calm second opinion for messages that feel off.

shot: Card with two example scam texts (fake delivery fee, 'Grandma, it's me').
lines: Scam texts and emails are built to make you act before you think.
A fake delivery fee. A grandchild in trouble.
The usual advice, be careful, doesn't help in the moment.
What helps is someone who reads the message with you, and points at the tricks.

shot: Live app home page; cursor moves to the message box and the privacy badge.
lines: So you paste the message into Second Look.
It runs entirely in your browser. There's no account, no server, and nothing is uploaded.

shot: Click 'Package delivery text' sample; verdict High risk; hover highlights; scroll to the link card.
lines: Here's a typical package delivery text.
Second Look says High risk, with four warning signs.
It marks the exact words: a redelivery fee, within 24 hours, will be returned to sender.
And it checks the link. The address starts with postal-service dot com, but the site you'd actually visit is help-center dot top.

shot: Click the grandparent sample; tap 'don't tell Mom' highlight, card flashes; tap 'gift cards'.
lines: Now, the grandparent scam.
Tap any marked phrase to see why it matters.
Don't tell Mom. Scammers isolate you, because a relative would spot the trick.
Gift cards, and send me the codes: money you can never get back.

shot: Scroll to 'What to do in the next 5 minutes'; click 'Ask someone I trust'; 'Copied' confirmation appears.
lines: Then it tells you what to do in the next five minutes, tailored to what it found, and always ending with what to do if you already paid.
Ask someone I trust copies a ready-to-send note, with the verdict and the message, so a family member can take a look.

shot: Click 'Normal reminder' sample; green Low risk verdict.
lines: A normal message stays calm. Low risk, with an honest reminder that no tool is a guarantee.

shot: Toggle 'A+ Larger text'; then the phone-size layout.
lines: There's a larger text mode for anyone who needs it, and it works on a phone.

shot: Slides: the devpost/ planning docs (scope, PRD, spec, checklist) and the 20 passing tests.
lines: I built Second Look for Build With AI: Basics, using the Devpost Skill Pack with an AI coding agent.
Scope came first, and it cut the obvious idea of plugging in an AI model. That would cost money, send private messages to a third party, and couldn't show why.
Instead: clear rules that point at the exact words.
Then a PRD with acceptance criteria, a technical spec, and four thin slices, each tested and committed.
Twenty automated tests include the messages that must stay calm.

shot: Closing card: live URL, GitHub repo, MIT license.
lines: Second Look is free, open source under the MIT license, and live on GitHub Pages.
Take a second look, before you act.
